description: Patient arrives and checks in at the front desk. Verify patient identity and appointment details.
Prepare patient for the imaging procedure. Review safety screening, remove metal objects, change into gown if required.
Position patient on the imaging table according to protocol requirements.
Acquire diagnostic images according to the imaging protocol.
Administer IV contrast agent if required by the protocol. Monitor patient for adverse reactions.
Reconstruct raw imaging data into diagnostic images using standard reconstruction algorithms.
Apply image enhancement techniques such as windowing, filtering, or artifact correction.
Create 3D volume renderings, multiplanar reconstructions, or MIP images as required.
Review acquired images for technical quality. Verify all required anatomy is captured and image quality is diagnostic.
Initial image review by radiology resident or trainee before attending radiologist review.
Attending radiologist interprets images and formulates diagnostic impression.
Dictate, review, and sign final radiology report. Communicate critical findings as required.
